box.highlights: Floyd 30, Sachem East 0: Dylan Harris rushed for 105 yards and two scores on eight carries to lead Floyd in its Suffolk I opener. Michael Turner had 11 tackles and a sack, Brian Benson added 10 tackles and a sack and Deontae Sykes totaled eight tackles, two sacks and a fumble recovery for a TD. Kicker and safety Caden Lesciewicz drilled a 39-yard field goal, converted three extra points, recovered a fumble, and intercepted a pass.

Floyd 24, Commack 21: Caden Lesiewicz made a 34-yard field goal with six seconds remaining in the fourth quarter to break a tie at 21 for Floyd (2-0) in Suffolk I. Dylan Harris rushed for 133 yards and two touchdowns on 16 carries, including a 65-yard score to give Floyd a 21-7 lead in the second quarter. Quentin Alba-Etheridge had a 24-yard interception return for a touchdown to give Floyd a 7-0 lead in the first quarter. Deontae Sykes added three sacks and Brian Benson had six tackles in the win.

Floyd 23, Longwood 6: Dylan Harris: rushed for 73 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries and Sonny Mayo rushed for  73 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries for Floyd (3-0) in Suffolk I. Nick Taiani rushed for 61 yards on six carries, including a 25-run yard touchdown run to give Floyd a 16-6 lead in the third quarter. Carlos Marquina recorded four tackles for loss, including two sacks, Brian Benson recorded two sacks and Deontay Sykes recorded eight tackles, including three for a loss and a sack for Floyd.
Whitman 27, Floyd 0: Nick Bottoni threw three touchdowns and ran for another to lead Whitman (4-0) in Suffolk I.

Floyd 28, Patchogue-Medford 13: Dylan Harris ran for 164 yards and three touchdowns on 20 carries and Michael Turner had 11 tackles, a sack and returned an interception 42-yards for a score to lead Floyd (4-1) in Suffolk I. Deonte Sykes had six tackles and two sacks and Brian Benson had five tackles and a sack.

Floyd 42, Sachem North 10: Running back Dylan Harris rushed for 150 yards and four touchdowns on 11 carries to lead Floyd (5-1) in Suffolk I. Brian Benson recorded seven tackles (two for a loss), Michael Turner made seven tackles (two for a loss) and one sack. Quarterback LaDuke Harris rushed for 120 yards and had a 60-yard TD run. Jaden Montalvo ran for a 63-yard score for the Colonials. Sachem North fell to 2-4.

Floyd 24, Brentwood 0: Dylan Harris rushed for 195 yards and two touchdowns on 14 carries in Suffolk I. Harris' touchdowns, both in the third quarter, came from 4 and 43 yards. The 4-yarder was set up by Jayden Montalvo's 80-yard kickoff return that began the second half. LaDuke Harris rushed for 120 yards on five carries and Deonte Sykes ran for a 43-yard touchdown. Sykes also made four tackles. Caden Lesiewicz nailed a 33-yard field goal in the second quarter that broke a scoreless tie, hit all three of his extra point attempts, made five tackles, knocked down three passes, and recovered a fumble for Floyd (6-1). Brentwood is 3-4.
Floyd 37, Ward Melville 15: Dylan Harris had 16 rushes for 130 and two touchdown's in Floyd's (7-1) win over Ward Melville in Suffolk I.

Floyd 42, Brentwood 0: Dylan Harris rushed for 60 yards and three touchdowns on five carries to lead Floyd in the first round of the Suffolk I playoffs. LaDuke Harris threw for 24 yards and rushed for 78 yards. Sonny Mayo rushed for 83 yards, two touchdowns, and returned an interception for a 60-yard score. Caden Lesiewicz intercepted two passes.

Floyd 31, Commack 16: Dylan Harris scored his third touchdown of the game from 1-yard out with 35 seconds remaining to cap a 14-play, 80-yard drive that spanned 8:21 on the game clock and helped No. 2 Floyd secure the win over No. 3 Commack in a Suffolk I semifinal.
Ryan Wald's 39-yard field goal had pulled Commack (7-3) to within one score before Floyd (9-1) embarked on the clinching drive.
"It was a battle, it was pretty much a one score game," Floyd coach Paul Longo said.
Dylan Harris finished the game with 138 yards on 18 carries. LaDuke Harris added a 68-yard touchdown run for Floyd, which led 17-0 after the first quarter.
Floyd is the three-time defending Suffolk I champion and will defend its title against No. 1 Whitman Friday at 7 p.m. at Stony Brook University. It will be the 17th Suffolk final for Floyd in the last 21 years.

Whitman 42, Floyd 7: Nicholas Bottoni threw for 205 yards and three touchdowns to lead No. 1 Whitman over No. 2 Floyd in the Suffolk I championship game. Bottoni connected with Tyriek Mays-Mckoy for a 33-yard touchdown in the first quarter and a 46-yard score in the third quarter. Mays-Mckoy finished with seven receptions for 171 yards. AJ Evans rushed for 81 yards and three touchdowns. This is the first Suffolk title for the Wildcats since 1984.  Whitman (11-0) will face Massapequa (10-1) on Friday at 12 p.m. in the Long Island Class I championship.
